invariants.rationale: The returned value is always negative or zero, since -(cursorLine - firstLineShowing + 1) is negative or zero and line heights are positive.
The result is computed directly in this way in the return statement.
Method calls style.font.getLineHeight(), so style.font must be non-null.
Access to style.font requires style to be non-null.
The sign of result depends on the sign of (cursorLine - firstLineShowing + 1) and getLineHeight().
